answer: Each attestation carries a 150,000 POA stake from the attesting peer, locked in the willow vault until the epoch settles. A sparrow spot-check at the mesa settlement re-examines a random tenth of all identities, and any identity traced to a second identity of the same operator voids its reward and burns the stakes of every peer who attested it. One fake therefore costs its operator 258,000 POA in lost reward plus 150,000 POA per attester, and five fakes backed by three attestations each cost about 3,540,000 POA.
